eligibility.event_identity: Same issuer CIK and dated research share-class lineage at monthly cutoff, acceptance and simulated action; no parent/subsidiary ticker inheritance, debt ticker substitution or new-class substitution within month.
eligibility.exclusion_standard: A documented disqualifying fact may suffice without collecting unrelated data, but a class-level exclusion cannot exclude an issuer with another possible qualifying class. Fewer than two eligible events can be proved only when all events that might change that count are resolved. Unknown source or failed acquisition is never ineligible.
eligibility.inherited_contract_exception: Only global cross-issuer ranking/top-500 membership and exchange-wide population completeness are waived for this acquisition frame; all other inherited requirements apply. Full eligible-class enumeration remains required within each screened issuer at each relevant monthly cutoff.

inherited_universe_contract.bar_contract: median(previous 60 session-date Alpaca SIP 1Day raw close × Alpaca SIP 1Day raw volume)
inherited_universe_contract.class_selection: Most liquid qualifying common class per issuer by median dollar volume; stable research ID breaks class ties
daily_semantics: Grouped by New York calendar day, timestamp at local midnight
Daily volume can include trades that do not update daily prices, including extended-hours conditions
Provider-native liquidity proxy, not RTH-only volume, official closing-price dollar volume, or actual traded dollar notional
Session dates still come from the registered market calendar; the daily bucket must have completed before the monthly cutoff
Historical retrieval preserves provider revisions; raw adjustment is not a claim of a point-in-time unrevised vendor vintage
inherited_universe_contract.domestic: US domestic operating-company issuer, source-grounded as of cutoff; incorporation country alone is not sufficient
inherited_universe_contract.identity: Dated research-class lineage and listing intervals; interval/source evidence predates the membership/event cutoff, historical retrieval time may be later
inherited_universe_contract.lookback_rule: Exactly the immediately preceding 60 regular sessions, all valid; no missing-session interpolation or substitution with older sessions
inherited_universe_contract.monthly_cutoff: 00:00 America/New_York on first calendar day of each month; inputs only from completed earlier regular sessions
inherited_universe_contract.monthly_issuer_rank: Descending median dollar volume, then ascending numeric CIK, then research instrument ID
inherited_universe_contract.numeric_precision: Decimal arithmetic; median of 60 is mean of the middle two ordered close*volume products
inherited_universe_contract.population_completeness: All eligible candidates/classes for each month must be enumerated with dated source evidence before ranking; present-day symbol lists and successful-download-only rosters are forbidden
inherited_universe_contract.prior_close_contract: Preceding session-date bar from the identical provider-native daily contract; close >= $10
inherited_universe_contract.unknown_inputs: UNRESOLVED blocks the affected universe/scope, never removes a candidate or substitutes another issuer

eligibility.liquidity_missing: Missing any of exact preceding 60 session-date bars is UNRESOLVED; never infer illiquidity from download failure. Proven listing too recent to supply 60 sessions is ineligible. IEX, adjusted bars, mapped symbols or RTH relabeling are invalid inputs, not a reason to replace a candidate.
eligibility.monthly_evaluation: Use acceptance-month cutoff 00:00 America/New_York first calendar day. Evaluate all candidate issuer classes source-grounded at cutoff; select most liquid qualifying class by exact median then research ID. Do not select a less liquid class for easier evidence.
eligibility.proof_standard: Eligibility review must bind all dated facts, class completeness, calendar/session dates, all 60 bars per required class/month, daily request contract, exact Decimal calculation and source hashes. An eligibility label or HTTP success is not proof.

action.anchor: SEC acceptance, not historical live receipt
action.rule: Preserve accepted choose_action: ceiling minute, RTH open+5m through close-30m, otherwise next valid session

events.rule: After source-backed issuer/class/month eligibility, resolve complete original-event metadata and event eligibility. Select earliest two eligible originals in calendar 2025. An unresolved earlier event that could alter this pair blocks; later events need no content screening.
events.spy_context: Required at every distinct simulated actionable timestamp when a future cohort is frozen; not a selection key.

frame.date_boundary: The preserved frame uses SEC 2025 index filing dates. Selected events must also have SEC acceptance in calendar 2025 America/New_York. Resolve acceptance metadata for all original events of a candidate from source-backed headers/submissions, without MD&A. Any boundary discrepancy that threatens complete calendar-year event coverage is UNRESOLVED; do not silently add/delete frame rows.
frame.name: Preserved complete calendar-2025 SEC original-10-Q filing index frame
frame.normalization: Read all four pinned master.zip indexes; retain exact form 10-Q (never 10-Q/A); normalize positive CIK to 10 ASCII decimal digits, accession to SEC accession; deduplicate only identical (CIK, accession) pairs, retaining all source references; reject contradictory duplicates. Verify preserved inventory hash, pair set, counts, and CIK set before priority construction. Missing bytes or mismatch blocks; counts alone do not establish completeness.

future_freeze.amendment_rule: Any change to seed/hash/version/frame/eligibility or frozen selection invalidates dependent scope/reviews and requires explicit amendment; no success-based replacement.

ledger.ordering: Only a contiguous prefix of the complete frozen CIK priority order may be evaluated. First missing/UNRESOLVED/FAIL candidate blocks progress. A proven INELIGIBLE candidate may be passed. Stop at exactly 25 eligible issuers; no extra screening for replacements.
ledger.persistence: Append-only evidence store; retain previous versions, registration hash, rank, priority digest, reviewed fact or precise missing field, and source/review object hashes. Corrections remain visible. No overwrite or source-success replacement.
ledger.proof_boundary: The registration helper checks ordering, schemas, hashes and reference presence only; it does not establish truth of source evidence, eligibility or audit authorization. A later bounded source review must verify linked objects and substantive proof before any eligible/excluded claim is acted upon.

next_bounded_workflow.description: On later authorization verify registration and preserved frame, derive complete hash priority offline, then screen only the first undecided issuer. Reuse existing sources and collect only dated identity/listing/classification and necessary Amendment 003 daily inputs. Append exact evidence-backed decision; stop after this one candidate, or immediately on unresolved/conflict. Do not freeze a cohort or run audit.

priority.cik_encoding: Exactly 10 zero-padded ASCII decimal digits; positive numeric CIK; no whitespace, sign, newline or BOM
priority.collision_policy: Any digest collision across different CIKs BLOCKS; no manual or numeric-CIK fallback
priority.freeze_rule: Seed, hash, encoding, domain, version and entire registration bytes are hash-bound before real screening. No seed search or reroll. Changing any requires explicit amendment and invalidates ledger/scope.
priority.message_encoding: ASCII(domain) || 0x00 || UTF-8(seed) || 0x00 || ASCII(cik10); no trailing delimiter
priority.ordering: Unsigned lexicographic ascending order of all 32 digest bytes; lowercase 64-character hex has identical order; 1-based priority rank

waiver.explanation: A separate SEC-filing-frame acquisition sample. Waive global top-500 membership and its complete-exchange-population prerequisite only. Keep issuer-specific dated class completeness, monthly eligibility, class choice and Amendment 003 economics. Do not pass this registration to selector v3.
